images.characterHint: MANDATORY ETHNICITY: Colombian Latin American MESTIZO man, 38 years old. SKIN TONE IS THE MOST CRITICAL FEATURE: warm olive-brown skin with visible bronze/tan undertones — the complexion of a mestizo Colombian, clearly DARKER than a caucasian European person. NOT pale, NOT ivory, NOT pinkish. Think Sofia Vergara's ethnicity or Maluma's skin tone as reference. HAIR PATTERN — this is also critical: dark brown/near-black hair on TOP of head, with salt-and-pepper SILVER-GRAY streaks concentrated ONLY at the TEMPLES (the sides above the ears) — NOT gray all over, NOT uniformly gray. Dark on crown + gray at temples = the correct pattern. BEARD: short trimmed full beard, dark with visible gray-white streaks mixed in (not fully gray, not fully dark). NECKLACE: thick silver figaro chain RESTING VISIBLY over the collar of a solid black polo — the chain must be clearly visible in frame, not hidden under clothing. BUILD: stocky robust build, broad shoulders, NOT slim, NOT lean. No hat. No cap. Bare head. Refs [1, 5, 6, 7].
